- Implemented as a web game using Three.js from a CDN, rather than a Unity project.
- Created a stylized tactical UI and low-poly industrial map.

- Added 12 operator entries and menu selection display.

- Changes are uncommitted.
- `js/world.js` was overwritten in the latest tool call and is incomplete; do not assume earlier gameplay implementation remains in the file.
- No build, runtime, or browser verification has been performed.

## Objective
- Complete the browser beta of **VEM COMER** as a playable 3D tactical-shooter match with operators, bots, rounds, and a bomb objective.

## Requirements
- Functional menu/operator selection, first-person movement and combat, abilities, bots, plant/defuse, round flow, HUD, and touch controls.
- Mobile-friendly presentation and modular, extensible game systems.
- Keep operators adult and fully clothed; operator-specific details were not provided, so placeholders are used.

## Decisions
- Use Three.js via CDN with a stylized industrial map and tactical UI.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the Portuguese menu, operator roster/settings dialogs, HUD, responsive styling, and 12 placeholder operator entries.
- Added the `createGame()` API in `js/world.js` for movement, firing/reloading, bots, abilities, objectives, rounds, and rendering.
- Added mouse firing and made touch interaction hold-to-interact in `js/main.js`.
- JavaScript syntax checks passed for `js/world.js` and `js/main.js`.

- Complete the browser beta of **VEM COMER** as a playable 3D tactical-shooter match with operators, bots, rounds, and a bomb objective.

## Requirements
- Functional menu/operator selection, first-person movement and combat, abilities, bots, plant/defuse, round flow, HUD, and touch controls.
- Mobile-friendly presentation and modular, extensible game systems.
- Keep operators adult and fully clothed; placeholders are used where operator details were unspecified.

## Decisions
- Use Three.js via CDN with a stylized industrial map and tactical UI.

### Completed
- Built the Portuguese menu, operator roster/settings dialogs, HUD, responsive styling, and 12 placeholder operator entries.
- Implemented `createGame()` in `js/world.js` for movement, firing/reloading, bots, abilities, objectives, rounds, and rendering.
- Added mouse firing and hold-to-interact touch controls.
- Added a data-URL favicon in `index.html`, eliminating the `/favicon.ico` 404.

- Verified desktop and mobile match entry, firing, reloading, and ability activation; JavaScript syntax checks passed.
- Browser console currently reports no errors or warnings after reload.

- Further test movement, aiming, bot behavior, plant/defuse interactions, and round flow; review/fix gameplay issues.

### Blocked
- Objective and round-flow behavior have not yet been verified in a complete match.

1. Test player movement/aiming and confirm bots detect and engage the player.
2. Exercise plant/defuse and round transitions, including match completion.

- `index.html`: Menu, dialogs, HUD, mobile controls, favicon.
- `styles.css`: Visual design, responsive layout, and touch-control styling.
- `js/main.js`: UI wiring, HUD updates, and input handlers.

- Changes are uncommitted.
